name: Eco Lodge
tagline: A nature lodge in the Chamarel hills
description: Five wooden cabins and a treehouse in the hills of Chamarel, Mauritius, next to the Black River Gorges. Book direct for the best price, breakfast included.

perks.title: 10% off every night
perks.text: The lowest price is always here, never on booking sites.

perks.title: Breakfast included
perks.text: Fruit from our garden, local coffee and fresh bread.

perks.title: Late check-out
perks.text: Stay until 2 pm on your last day, when the room allows.

perks.title: Free airport transfer
perks.text: For stays of 3 nights or more.

promises.label: of breakfast grown on the island

experiences.title: Waterfall hike
experiences.text: A guided morning walk down to a hidden pool below the falls.

experiences.title: Sunrise yoga
experiences.text: On the deck above the valley, mats and tea provided.

experiences.title: Garden dinner
experiences.text: A Creole set menu from our garden and the village market.

experiences.title: Gorges viewpoint
experiences.text: Fifteen minutes on foot to one of the island's great views.

faqs.q: Why is it cheaper to book direct?
faqs.a: Booking sites charge us a commission of around 15–20%. When you book with us, we pass part of that saving back to you, and add breakfast and late check-out.
It helps for exploring, but it isn't required. We arrange airport transfers (free from 3 nights) and taxis to the beaches.

faqs.q: Is it cool in the hills?
faqs.a: Chamarel is a few degrees cooler than the coast, especially at night. Every room has fans and warm blankets; no air conditioning is needed.
Yes. The Family Lodge sleeps five, and we have cots and high chairs on request.
Free cancellation up to 7 days before arrival. After that, the first night is charged.
